sources.content: AGENTS.md for gavrin. Gavrin is a forward proxy for outbound traffic from build machines, written in TypeScript on Node.js 20. Install with `pnpm install` and run the tests with `pnpm test`. The allowlist of reachable hosts is in `config/allowlist.txt`, one host per line, sorted alphabetically. Every change to the allowlist needs approval from the security team in the pull request. The proxy listens on port 3128. Run `pnpm build` to compile the code into `dist/`.

Source code is in `src/`, and request filters live in `src/filters/`, one class per file. Use the logger from `src/log.ts` instead of `console.log`, and never log the Proxy-Authorization header. Tests use vitest and live next to the code as `*.test.ts` files. Run `pnpm lint` before pushing; the lint step fails on any unused export. Releases are tagged vX.Y.Z on the main branch, and CI publishes each one as a container image.
